pages.text: $(bold)Defense-slot modifier - Stuffed Ears$(): plug your ears and let them curse the heavens.(br2)Restriction: $(l)helmets only$() (Tinkers' helmet parts), single level, costs $(bold)1 defense slot$().(br2)Usage: press the $(bold)Tinkers' helmet interaction key$() (TCon's "Helmet Interaction" binding, default Z) to toggle the earplugs. The state is stored on that helmet, so each helmet remembers its own.

$(bold)While on$():$(li)You $(bold)hear no sound at all$() (steps, mobs, music - everything is muted)$(li)You $(bold)ignore cursed speech$() - never picked as a chant target and immune to its area effect (the caster still takes their own backlash)(br2)$(bold)While off$(): everything is normal again, both sound and cursed speech affect you.(br2)Recipe: White Wool + Honeycomb + String.
